# `gh-tmpl show`

- **Usage:** `gh-tmpl show [FLAGS] [kind]`

Print a pull request or issue template.

The kind defaults to pr. With several templates and no --name, the command
lists them and exits 2. A pull request uses the single-file template, such as
.github/pull_request_template.md, when there is one.

An issue form (.yml) prints as Markdown sections that match the body GitHub
writes for a submitted form. Use --raw to print the YAML.

## Arguments
- **`[kind]`** — The template kind: pr (the default) or issue

  **Choices:** `pr`, `issue`

## Flags
- **`--name <template>`** — Pick the template with this ID, file name or name
- **`--form <name>`** — Pick the issue form with this ID and print it as Markdown
- **`--raw`** — Print the file as it is, front matter or YAML included
- **`--json`** — Print JSON
- **`--list`** — List the templates
- **`-R --repo <repo>`** — Read the templates of [HOST/]OWNER/REPO through the API
- **`--offline`** — Do not read the owner's shared .github repository

## Examples

```
gh tmpl show pr > body.md
```

```
gh tmpl show issue --list
```

```
gh tmpl show issue --form bug_report > body.md
```

```
gh tmpl show issue --name feature_request --json
```
